unitTitle: Video Project — Unit 8: The Mask of Zorro (137')

pairsWith.noteUz: 8-unit (A Brush with Danger) dan keyin ko'riladi: past perfect (after/because), xavf va qutqaruv mavzusi.

scanNote:
VIDEO PROJECT - UNIT 8: THE MASK OF ZORRO (137') (91-bet, PDF 76). Yuqorida 'UNIT 8 The Mask of Zorro (137')', o'ngda kinoproyektor. SURAT: film afishasi - chapda Elena (Ketrin Zeta-Jons) va Don Diego (Entoni Xopkins), o'rtada katta 'Z' harfi va 'THE MASK OF ZORRO', o'ngda Alejandro (Antonio Banderas).

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the picture. Name the characters. Who was the first Zorro?'
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Zorro gives ...... to one of the two young boys in the square. A a watch B a medallion C a coin. 2 Don Diego de la Vega (Zorro) arrests ...... . A Rafael Montero B Ralph Mills C Richard Monroe. 3 The name of Zorro's horse is ...... . A Typhoon B Twister C Tornado. 4 Esperanza, Zorro's wife is ...... . A shot B stabbed C poisoned. 5 The Murrieta brothers are ...... . A Albert and John B Alejandro and Joanquil C Anthony and James. 6 There is ...... in the mine. A coal B silver C gold.
3) 'Put the events into the correct order.' a Alejandro goes to the banquet. b The slaves are set free from the mine. c Alejandro and Elena meet. d Elena and Alejandro marry and have a son. e Don Diego dies. 1 ...... 2 ...... 3 ...... 4 ...... 5 ......
4) 'Join the sentences using the past perfect simple and the words in brackets.' 1 Alejandro became the next Zorro. Don Diego trained him. (after)

O'NG USTUN:
2 Captain Love killed Joanquil. He put his head in a jar. (after) 3 Don Diego looked old and dirty. He was in prison for 20 years. (because) 4 Elena thought Rafael was her father. She was brought up by him. (because) 5 The old woman recognized Elena. She was her nanny. (because)
5) 'Mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).' 1 The story is set in California. 2 Alejandro and Joanquil were from a rich family. 3 Don Diego teaches Alejandro to become a gentleman. 4 Zorro's mark is the letter 'X'. 5 Elena finds out who her real father is.
'TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION': 1 Can you name some other fictional heroes who are 'servants of the people'? 2 Who are the people in real life who rescue us from danger? 3 Have you ever been rescued from danger? Tell the class.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '91'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Name the characters. Who was the first Zorro?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. Qahramonlarni ayting. Birinchi Zorro kim edi?
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM HAQIDA: 'The Mask of Zorro'
  (1998). Kaliforniya, 1800-yillar.
  Don Diego de la Vega - birinchi
  Zorro (niqobli xalq himoyachisi).
  Yovuz gubernator Rafael Montero
  uni qamoqqa tashlaydi, xotinini
  o'ldiradi va qizi Elenani o'ziga
  oladi. 20 yildan keyin Don Diego
  o'g'ri Alejandro Murrieta'ni
  yangi Zorro qilib tarbiyalaydi.

  SURATDAGILAR: Elena (chapda), Don
  Diego de la Vega (o'rtada, keksa),
  Alejandro Murrieta (o'ngda).
  Birinchi Zorro - DON DIEGO DE LA
  VEGA.

items.question: Who are the characters in the picture?
items.answer: They are Elena, Don Diego de la Vega and Alejandro Murrieta.

items.question: Who was the first Zorro?
items.answer: Don Diego de la Vega was the first Zorro.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Don Diego - asl Zorro; Alejandro - uning vorisi.

exercises.explanationUz:
FILM FAKTLARI.

  1 A MEDALLION - Zorro bolaga
    medalyon beradi (keyin
    Alejandro bo'lib chiqadi)
  2 RAFAEL MONTERO - yovuz
    gubernator
  3 TORNADO - Zorroning oti
  4 Esperanza SHOT - otib
    o'ldirilgan
  5 ALEJANDRO and JOANQUIL Murrieta
    - aka-uka o'g'rilar
  6 GOLD in the mine - oltin koni


⚠ 'A MEDALLION':

  = medalyon (bo'yin taqinchog'i).


⚠ SHOT / STABBED / POISONED:

  = otilgan / pichoqlangan /
  zaharlangan.

items.textEn: Zorro gives ___ to one of the two young boys in the square.
items.uz: Zorro maydondagi ikki boladan biriga medalyon beradi.

items.textEn: Don Diego de la Vega (Zorro) arrests ___.
items.uz: Don Diego de la Vega (Zorro) Rafael Monteroni hibsga oladi.

items.textEn: The name of Zorro's horse is ___.

items.whyUz: ⚠ Montero yashirin oltin konida qullarni ishlatadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the events into the correct order: a Alejandro goes to the banquet. b The slaves are set free from the mine. c Alejandro and Elena meet. d Elena and Alejandro marry and have a son. e Don Diego dies.
exercises.instructionUz: Voqealarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying: a Alejandro ziyofatga boradi. b Qullar kondan ozod qilinadi. c Alejandro va Elena uchrashadi. d Elena va Alejandro turmush qurib, o'g'il ko'radi. e Don Diego vafot etadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
VOQEALAR TARTIBI:

  1 c - Alejandro va Elena uchrashadi
  2 a - Alejandro ziyofatga boradi
    (Montero'nikiga)
  3 b - Qullar kondan ozod qilinadi
  4 e - Don Diego vafot etadi (jang
    oxirida)
  5 d - Elena va Alejandro turmush
    quradi, o'g'il ko'radi


⚠ 'A BANQUET':

  = katta ziyofat.


⚠ 'TO SET FREE':

  = ozod qilmoq.

items.whyUz: ⚠ Don Diego uni janob qilib ziyofatga yuboradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Join the sentences using the past perfect simple and the words in brackets. 1 Alejandro became the next Zorro. Don Diego trained him. (after) 2 Captain Love killed Joanquil. He put his head in a jar. (after) 3 Don Diego looked old and dirty. He was in prison for 20 years. (because) 4 Elena thought Rafael was her father. She was brought up by him. (because) 5 The old woman recognized Elena. She was her nanny. (because)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni past perfect simple va qavsdagi so'zlar yordamida birlashtiring. 1 Alejandro keyingi Zorro bo'ldi. Don Diego uni o'rgatdi. (after) 2 Kapitan Lav Joaquinni o'ldirdi. U boshini bankaga solib qo'ydi. (after) 3 Don Diego keksa va kir ko'rinardi. U 20 yil qamoqda edi. (because) 4 Elena Rafaelni otasi deb o'ylardi. Uni Rafael tarbiyalagan. (because) 5 Kampir Elenani tanidi. U uning enagasi edi. (because)
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT - 8-unit
  grammatikasi.

  OLDINGI harakat → had + V3
  KEYINGI harakat → past simple

  after + had V3, past simple
  past simple + because + had V3

  ⚠ Majhul: had been brought up,
  had been in prison.


⚠ 'TO BRING UP':

  = tarbiyalamoq, katta qilmoq.


⚠ 'A NANNY':

  = enaga.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 After Don Diego had trained him, Alejandro became the next Zorro.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Don Diego uni o'rgatgandan keyin Alejandro keyingi Zorro bo'ldi.
modelAnswers: 1 After Don Diego had trained him, Alejandro became the next Zorro.
2 After Captain Love had killed Joanquil, he put his head in a jar.
3 Don Diego looked old and dirty because he had been in prison for 20 years.
4 Elena thought Rafael was her father because she had been brought up by him.
5 The old woman recognized Elena because she had been her nanny.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Don Diego uni o'rgatgandan keyin Alejandro keyingi Zorro bo'ldi. (had trained - oldingi)
2 Kapitan Lav Joaquinni o'ldirgandan keyin boshini bankaga solib qo'ydi. (had killed - oldingi)
3 Don Diego keksa va kir ko'rinardi, chunki u 20 yil qamoqda bo'lgan edi. (had been)
4 Elena Rafaelni otasi deb o'ylardi, chunki uni Rafael tarbiyalagan edi. (had been brought up - majhul)
5 Kampir Elenani tanidi, chunki u uning enagasi bo'lgan edi. (had been)

exercises.instructionEn: Mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM FAKTLARI.

  1 T - Kaliforniya (Meksika
    hukmronligi davri)
  2 F - Murrieta aka-ukalari kambag'al
    o'g'rilar
  3 T - Don Diego Alejandro'ni janob
    qilib tarbiyalaydi
  4 F - Zorro belgisi 'Z' harfi
  5 T - Elena haqiqiy otasi Don
    Diego ekanini bilib oladi


⚠ 'TO BE SET IN':

  = (voqea) ... da bo'lib o'tmoq.


⚠ 'A GENTLEMAN':

  = janob, oliy tabaqa vakili.

exercises.instructionEn: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Can you name some other fictional heroes who are 'servants of the people'? 2 Who are the people in real life who rescue us from danger? 3 Have you ever been rescued from danger? Tell the class.
exercises.instructionUz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 'Xalq xizmatchisi' bo'lgan boshqa xayoliy qahramonlarni ayta olasizmi? 2 Haqiqiy hayotda bizni xavfdan qutqaradigan odamlar kimlar? 3 Hech qachon xavfdan qutqarilganmisiz? Sinfga aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHOKAMA - 8-unit (A Brush with
  Danger) mavzusi.

  1 Robin Hood, Batman, Superman,
    Spider-Man ...
  2 firefighters, police officers,
    doctors, lifeguards, coastguards
  3 'Yes, I have. Once I ... and a
    lifeguard rescued me.' / 'No, I
    have never been rescued from
    danger.'


⚠ 'FICTIONAL':

  = xayoliy, to'qima.


⚠ 'TO RESCUE':

  = qutqarmoq.

points.en: Can you name some other fictional heroes who are 'servants of the people'?
points.uz: 'Xalq xizmatchisi' bo'lgan boshqa xayoliy qahramonlarni ayta olasizmi?
points.noteUz: Namuna: 'Robin Hood, Batman, Superman and Spider-Man are fictional heroes who help people.' (Robin Gud, Betmen, Supermen va O'rgimchak odam - odamlarga yordam beradigan xayoliy qahramonlar.)

points.en: Who are the people in real life who rescue us from danger?
points.uz: Haqiqiy hayotda bizni xavfdan qutqaradigan odamlar kimlar?
points.noteUz: Namuna: 'Firefighters, police officers, doctors, lifeguards and coastguards rescue people from danger.' (O't o'chiruvchilar, politsiyachilar, shifokorlar, qutqaruvchilar.)

points.en: Have you ever been rescued from danger? Tell the class.
points.uz: Hech qachon xavfdan qutqarilganmisiz? Sinfga aytib bering.
points.noteUz: Namuna: 'Yes, I have. Once I fell into the river and my uncle jumped in and pulled me out.' (Ha. Bir marta daryoga tushib ketdim, amakim sakrab meni tortib oldi.)

patterns.formula: After + KIM + had + V3, KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: After Don Diego had trained him, Alejandro became the next Zorro.
patterns.exampleUz: Don Diego uni o'rgatgandan keyin Alejandro keyingi Zorro bo'ldi.

patterns.formula: KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON + because + KIM + had (been) + V3
patterns.exampleEn: Don Diego looked old because he had been in prison for 20 years.
patterns.exampleUz: Don Diego keksa ko'rinardi, chunki u 20 yil qamoqda bo'lgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been rescued from danger?
